nom: La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Dark Spot Face Cleanser with Melasyl and Niacinamide

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily t-zones report the cleanser balances oiliness and reduces congestion without over-drying.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe pre-existing dry, rough or flaky skin mostly report the cleanser is gentle and non-drying, though a few of them also found it strips or dries their skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report no irritation or breakouts and note fading dark spots, though one describes it as too strong, causing itchiness and dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely report the formula is gentle, fragrance-light and non-stinging, with fading of spots, though one very sensitive reviewer had a severe cystic breakout.
segments.mature: One older reviewer reports no breakouts or reactions and continued use, valuing it for aging skin without dryness.

concerns.aging: A small number of reviewers mention fine lines or skin looking more youthful/firmer after use, but this is not a major recurring theme.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out skin and leaves it soft or hydrated; several others explicitly report drying, flaking or tightness, especially with frequent use.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or stinging; one reviewer notes the product can cause redness when overused, and another with sensitive skin had no issue at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers highlight that the cleanser cleans without stripping or leaving a tight or filmy feeling, supporting a comfortable barrier; two reviewers had cystic acne flare-ups they attribute to the paired serum's niacinamide strength.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma or acne scars within one to several weeks; a couple of reviewers with longer-standing dark spots saw only minimal or no lightening.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and fading acne scars, including hormonal and period-related acne; however, two reviewers report the product (paired with the serum) triggered severe cystic acne breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers note reduced oil production and a balanced t-zone; most others do not mention oiliness as a concern.

aspects.libelle: Drying or flaking with regular use
Fragrance disliked by some sensitive users
Small amount goes a long way, good value

extraits.texte: I used this with the corresponding face serum for 3 weeks and it caused a major breakout of deep painful acne all over my face. When I quit using it, my skin rapidly healed and has been fine since. I don't know what ingredient caused this (maybe the high concentration of niacinamide?) but this product isn't for me. It did lighten hyperigmentation but didn't improve melasma.

extraits.titre: Works wonders but dries your face
extraits.texte: I bought this cleanser as a substitute for the serum version as it was more affordable and somehow the cleanser managed to not only lighten my dark spots but my face overall. I have never seen my face this cleared up from acne and I have extremely stubborn skin. The biggest concern I have about this product is that its super drying. It has dried my face to the extent where some parts experience peeling/flaking. Due to this, I had to use extra moisturizer or hydrating products as the product can cause redness as well. A little goes a long way, make sure not to use too much otherwise your skin will be harmed rather than healed.

I got this less for evening skintone, but more for gentle exfoliation. I have pretty congested skin with a very oily tzone but dry elsewhere. This both treats the congestion through exfoliation but balances out my entire face really well without drying out or irritation. Ive noticed a huge difference in my pore size. Very much recommend if your skin sounds like mine.

First off let me say that I love everything by this brand! For someone with extremely sensitive skin, their products have helped me tremendously! This cleanser is nothing short of amazing! It smells soo good, is like a thick gel consistency which I love actually, and the bottle is bigger than what I thought it would be which is a huge plus! My skin breaks out so badly during my period and I got this product 2 weeks before my period and I started using it immediately and this is the clearest my face has ever been on my period!!

What an amazing face wash! It has been very effective at cleaning my skin without over drying it. I have combination skin that can be sensitive to fragrances. This doesn't bother me at all. I do believe it'll aid in keeping my skin clear and healthy. I use this in combination with the serum and they're amazing together. I will continue to use this product to see how it aids in dark spot reduction. It's scoring high points in all the other areas.

This product is heaven sent. My face feels so much smoother already after just one week. I have always struggled with dry and rough skin, but ever since I started using this product, I can't believe the transformation. The texture of the cream is so luxurious and it absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving any greasy residue. Not only does it make my skin feel incredibly smooth, but it also provides deep hydration that lasts throughout the day. I used to constantly battle with flaky patches, especially during the colder months, but this product has completely resolved that issue. I wake up every morning with a radiant and moisturized complexion that makes me feel confident and ready to take on the day. The results after just one week have exceeded my expectations. I have noticed a significant reduction in fine lines and wrinkles, making my skin appear more youthful and plump. It's amazing how a single product can have such a transformative effect on my overall appearance. Additionally, the heavenly scent of this product is an absolute delight. The fragrance is subtle yet lingering, creating a soothing and relaxing experience every time I apply it. It's become a part of my daily self-care routine, and I genuinely look forward to pampering my skin with this indulgent treat. I am truly grateful for discovering
